goal: observe/stt-wer.fk tokenizes text into words with sw-tokens. Persian writes one word both with and without a zero-width non-joiner (U+200C, UTF-8 bytes 226 128 140) or a zero-width joiner (U+200D, bytes 226 128 141), so the same word is counted as two different words. Remove those two characters before tokenizing: add a new function (defn sw-drop-joiners (s) ...), with a helper loop of its own over the bytes of s that copies every byte except these two three-byte sequences, and change sw-tokens so it tokenizes (sw-drop-joiners text) instead of text. Leave sw-token-loop and every other definition exactly as they are; the new code is a new definition and a changed sw-tokens, nothing wrapped around existing code.

form/form-stdlib/form-bml-refusal.fk names where the cursor stops reading a form.bml section, so a section the cursor refuses can say its line and the first word it could not read. (fbr-stop text) is given: it answers the byte offset where the section's statements stop, and (str_len text) or more when every statement reads. Add five new definitions inside the (do ...), after fbr-stop and before the final 0. (defn fbr-line-loop (text i pos n) ...) answers n when (ge i pos); otherwise it goes on with (add i 1) and adds 1 to n when (eq (str_byte_at text i) 10), a newline byte. (defn fbr-line-at (text pos) (fbr-line-loop text 0 pos 1)) is the 1-based line of byte pos. (defn fbr-word-end (text i) ...) answers i when (ge i (str_len text)) or when (cp-in-class? (str_byte_at text i) "bmlname") is false, and otherwise goes on with (add i 1). (defn fbr-word-at (text pos) ...) answers "" when (ge pos (str_len text)); otherwise it lets e be (fbr-word-end text pos) and answers (substring text pos e) when (gt e pos), else (substring text pos (add pos 1)). (defn fbr-refusal (text) ...) lets stop be (fbr-stop text) and answers (nothing) when (ge stop (str_len text)), otherwise (list (fbr-line-at text stop) (fbr-word-at text stop)). In Form a let is (let name value) inside a (do ...) whose last form is the answer, and every if has a then and an else. Leave fbr-stop and the header exactly as they are; the new code is new definitions only.
